job.job_description:
Hi All,




Job location - Bengaluru & Chennai

Duration of the assignment - 1 year (Extendable on the basis of performance & Client discretion)




Please find the detailed JD below,

Job Title: AI Engineer (Python, AI/ML, LLMs, Agentic AI)
Experience: 6+ Years
Job location - Bengaluru & Chennai

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Engineer to build, scale, and deploy next-generation AI and GenAI solutions. The role involves working on Python-based development, machine learning models, LLMs, and Agentic AI systems to solve real-world business problems and enhance customer experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and GenAI applications
Build solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, or LLaMA
Develop Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases
Work on end-to-end AI lifecycle: data processing model building deployment monitoring
Develop scalable backend systems using Python and APIs
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms and workflows
Optimize prompts, model performance, latency, and cost
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, business)
Ensure adherence to Responsible AI, security, and compliance standards

Required Skills

Core Engineering

Strong programming experience in Python
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design
Experience building APIs / backend services

AI / ML & Deep Learning

Hands-on with ML algorithms (regression, classification, NLP)
Experience with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn

LLM / GenAI

Experience with:
OpenAI / Azure OpenAI / Hugging Face
Prompt engineering
Embeddings & fine-tuning
Building applications like:
Chatbots
Q&A systems
Text summarization / classification

Agentic AI & Advanced GenAI

Experience with:
LangChain / LlamaIndex / AutoGen / CrewAI
Knowledge of:
Multi-agent workflows
Reasoning pipelines

RAG & Data Systems

Experience building RAG pipelines
Knowledge of vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate)



Interested candidates please share your updated resume to @ Neha.Anjum@in.ey.com

Thanks, and Regards,

Neha Anjum A | Project Consultant | People Consulting.
